title: Street profile (plan D2)
description: What the local model may choose for a map: one enumerated id per field, never a number or a free value. Each field has map_default, which changes nothing. Code turns each id into an existing, validated stage flag (docs/10-ai.md, Street profile). The area, the sources, the export, the budgets and the geometry of OSM buildings have no field here. summary is unverified text that no code reads.

dominant_typology.description: The map-wide facade atlas style of config/facade_styles.json (materials --facade-style, ADR-020/027). It never reclassifies a building (ADR-024).

palette.description: extended_pools: the calm roof and paving pools and the per-cell ground phase (materials --repetition, ADR-009 C1).

props_profile.description: Which library conditions overgrow may place (overgrow --selection, ADR-010).

cover.description: The sightline cover count when the map already has sightline_cover (perf cover --max-props, ADR-032 C7).

summary.description: One short sentence. Unverified text: stored, never read by code.
